verdict.rationale: Datalab documents Pipelines as chained processors in "versioned, reusable configurations" that deploy to production, and published agent processors can be pinned to a specific version via <id>@<version>. Pinning an older version implies a rollback path, but explicit review and rollback workflows are not documented. Missing for 10: a documented review or diff workflow for pipeline changes, an explicit rollback or restore mechanism, version history or audit views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
